ghkey.bad_format: This doesn’t look like a GitHub key (personal access token): it starts with ghp_ or github_pat_ and contains only Latin letters, digits and “_”.
ghkey.http: GitHub returned {code} — check the key again later.
ghkey.net: No connection to GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com): the key wasn’t checked.
ghkey.no_repo: With this key GitHub doesn’t serve the core files of the repository {repo} (response 404): the key is wrong or has no access to this repository.
ghkey.refused: GitHub didn’t accept the key (response {code}): it’s wrong, revoked or expired.
